name: pt9-warfare-te-end-turn-mid-action
description: Playtest 9 pbd539 (058): during Thunder's Edge Warfare's tactical action the post-action turn menu offered End Turn while ships were being picked. Fix (bot pt9-followups, ScFollowGate.endTurnRefusal): End Turn is refused while the tactical action is under way (a system active, the action not concluded), both as an engine answer and as a legacy click; once the action is concluded the turn ends. Base: sc-warfare-te-activate (pbd28 r1, Mahact holds Thunder's Edge Warfare).
